weather_report:
Late morning in Subiaco sits under a bright overcast, the sun reduced to a pale coin and most shadows washed away. The day looks muted and calm for now, with a soft, slightly hazed clarity that gentles the colors. Light showers are set to arrive from mid-afternoon toward evening, so any sunshine will be brief and milky rather than bold. Even so, spring UV can still nip when the cloud thins, so a touch of sunscreen and a hat make quiet sense.

Dress in light layers: a breathable shirt, a packable rain jacket or small umbrella for later, and shoes that won’t grumble at a sprinkle. It feels pleasant enough for late-morning errands or a slow wander before the first drops, then better suited to tucked‑indoors pursuits—a library run, a matinee, or a window seat with something to read while the rain freckles the pavement. By day’s end, expect the sky to settle into a gentle gray and the streets to shine a little.
